description: This file defines the class `TableTreeNode`, which extends `DefaultMutableTreeNode`. It provides methods to manage and access `TableFrame` objects within a tree structure, including retrieving the associated `Table`, and setting or getting a tooltip text.

classes.name: TableTreeNode
classes.description: A tree node class for representing `TableFrame` objects in a Swing `JTree` structure.

methods.name: TableTreeNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the node with a `TableFrame` object.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the `TableFrame` object associated with this node.

methods.name: setFrame
methods.description: Sets the `TableFrame` object for this node.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the `Table` associated with this node's `TableFrame`.

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.description: Sets a tooltip text for this node.

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip text for this node.
